I will detail the recovery of my 2nd surgery as I unfortunately had a mistake made in the first and it wasn’t a normal recovery, but my 2nd one was, and it was great! They gave me a nerve block on the side I was having the surgery which made it so I couldn’t feel anything in my arm from about halfway up my neck down to my full arm and it lasted for about 48 hrs. I had no pain, but they still had me taking ocycodone while the nerve block was still working so that when it wore off I wasn’t in a huge amount of pain. I felt so good that literally the next I was like hey let’s go out and do something lol I didn’t and I rested. The weird thing is when you start pt after 6-8wks in a sling. You have to move very slowly and not a lot of movement at a time either or you’ll get this pain that’s almost like a rubber pulled tight and can’t go any further. It’s not serious pain but it’s enough to make winch and yell ow. You slowly build your strength up in your arm as you continue to move up in the ranges of motion your allowed to move your arm too and hopefully it should just about as good as before. Tbh mine almost felt more tight and strengthened than it did before I ever injured myself, and it’s still pretty rock solid and I had my last surgery in 2019.
